arStrings.szText: Cold Imbuement

{c_important}Cold Imbued{/c} Skills cause enemies to become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_22}]{/c} seconds. {c_important}Cold Imbuement's{/c} Duration is increased by {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Frozen Heart

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Cold Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} chance to encase you in a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life, up to {c_number}[{SF_31}*{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c}, for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_B_BARRIER}{/c} seconds. This {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} reduces your Energy costs by {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|%|]{/c}.
Buffered Battery

When {c_important}Cold Imbuement{/c} is Cast it now also creates a frigid emanation around you for {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} seconds that deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_COLD}{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} any enemies within for {c_number}[{SF_25}|%|]{/c} every {c_number}[{SF_29}|1|]{/c} seconds.
Crystal Distillation
{c_important}Cold Imbued{/c} Skills grant {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} Energy when hitting an enemy for the first time.
Energy
When {c_important}Cold Imbuement{/c} {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} an enemy, {c_important}Cold Imbuement's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_38}|1|]{/c} seconds.
Cooldown
When {c_important}Cold Imbuement{/c} {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} an enemy, you have a {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|%|]{/c} chance to gain {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
Resolve
When you {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} an enemy while {c_important}Cold Imbued{/c}, gain {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
Overpower
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Cold Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} chance to make enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds.
Enhanced Cold Imbuement
{c_important}Cold Imbuement{/c} applies to {c_number}[SF_17]{/c} additional {c_important}Imbueable{/c} Skills and reduces their Energy cost by {c_number}[SF_16|%|]{/c}.
Blended Cold Imbuement
